corpus: 0.45 golden archetypes — RequirementsStudio + employee starter seeds (0.45-shaped, v7 style blocks)
note: Archetype keys are the single eight-archetype vocabulary in shesha-form-edit/references/archetypes.md (backed by shesha-design-comprehension/assets/blueprint.schema.json). These files are COMPILER INPUT and grep targets — never read one whole [R-050]. Reference reading only (see references/compiling.md 'Seeds still matter'); agents pick via this index. Two entries carry an explicit 'status': 'unsupported' — see references/archetypes.md's Unsupported section — they are kept for corpus value but are not part of the eight and have no flow manifest or compiler support.

forms.description: Entity worklist: dataContext(v8) + datatable, toolbar with Add (Show Dialog modal), quick search, pager, row navigate action column.

Inline-edit grid variant of table-worklist (fragment, not a standalone archetype — renamed from the P2 'inline-card' key which had no P1 equivalent): crud-operations column, editComponent {type,settings} shapes, canEditInline flags [R-010].
Single-record detail: header band, Start Edit/Submit/Cancel lifecycle buttonGroup, labelled field sections.

Main+rail record detail (962/332 split): flex containers sized via desktop.dimensions.width, KIB-style meta strip, tabs, related panels, Start Edit/Submit/Cancel Edit lifecycle. Largest fixture — grep only. Renamed from 'hub--rs-detail-with-header.json': verified (Start Edit/Submit/Cancel Edit actions present) as a record-detail page, not a P1 hub landing page — P1's 'hub' means a navigation-tile landing screen (see assets/archetypes/hub.flow.json), a false friend with P2's 'hub' meaning this shape.
Create/edit page: input fields, validationErrors, Save(Submit/shesha.form primary) + Back buttonGroup. Renamed from 'capture--employee-create.json' ('capture' -> 'standalone-capture').

Minimal standalone create form (smallest capture exemplar — the floor shape: fields + validationErrors + Save/Back). Renamed from 'capture-standalone--standalone-create.json' ('capture-standalone' -> 'standalone-capture' — near-identical name/word-order, the loser is not referenced anywhere else in the tree).

Create dialog opened via Show Dialog: editable fields, preset-FK pattern (component + onPrepareSubmitData), dialog-close wiring. Renamed from 'modal-dialog--rs-create-dialog.json' ('modal-dialog' -> 'capture-dialog'). The dialog chrome supplies Save/Cancel — this form body does NOT author its own Submit button; do not add one.
Card list: dataContext + datalist (formSelectionMode name) pointing at the item card form.

The datalist row-template card (bound text, fit-content dimensions, ellipsis, status chip row) [R-048] — the row-template published form a list-card's datalist declares as its `rowTemplate` dependency, not a separate archetype. Renamed from 'list-card-item--entity-card.json' to keep the archetype-prefix convention resolving to one of the eight.
Entity-bound landing/dashboard: stat containers + chart placeholders + shortcut links.

UNSUPPORTED-FOR-NOW (see references/archetypes.md's Unsupported section) — not one of the eight, no flow manifest, no compiler support. Anonymous full-page form (access:5): login/register/OTP shell — branded page chrome, input fields, Submit wired to an app-service endpoint [R-041], no entity CRUD. Manual-clone only (the compiler does not wire anonymous auth); kept in the corpus for reference reading, never as a compileSpec() build target.
